guides.concept: 本課以「由地下水路徑、反應時間與介質老化設計反應牆教學模型」為主軸，依序處理污染羽流與牆位概念、反應介質與可用容量、柱試驗動力學、孔隙堵塞與流速變化、牆內外井網驗證。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on Build a reactive-barrier teaching model from groundwater pathways, reaction time and media ageing, progressing through Plume and conceptual barrier position, Reactive medium and usable capacity, Column-test kinetics, Pore clogging and velocity change, Inside/outside monitoring network. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

evidence: 針對「污染羽流與牆位概念」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「被動穿流與水力匹配」，測井口標高並校正液位，將多井等水頭線與地層圖共同判讀。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「反應介質與可用容量」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「牆厚與接觸時間」，以柱試驗求動力學，再用上下游井與示蹤驗證是否穿越反應區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「柱試驗動力學」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「反應序列與中間物」，以莫耳量核對母物、中間物與終產物，附回收率和未量測支路。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「孔隙堵塞與流速變化」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「介質耗盡與負荷波動」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「牆內外井網驗證」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「壽命、維護與證據交接」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
evidenceEn: For Plume and conceptual barrier position, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Passive flow and hydraulic matching, Survey reference elevations, correct water levels and interpret multiwell contours with stratigraphy. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Reactive medium and usable capacity, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Wall thickness and contact time, Obtain kinetics from column tests, then use wells and tracers to verify passage through the reactive zone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Column-test kinetics, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Reaction sequence and intermediates, Reconcile parent, intermediates and products on a molar basis, including recovery and unmeasured branches. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Pore clogging and velocity change, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Media exhaustion and loading variation, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Inside/outside monitoring network, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Life, maintenance and evidence handoff, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
pitfalls: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「污染羽流與牆位概念」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
不同濾管深度或時間的液位可能產生假的水平梯度。 在「被動穿流與水力匹配」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「反應介質與可用容量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
牆體阻力增大可使污染羽流繞過，單測牆內濃度會漏判。 在「牆厚與接觸時間」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「柱試驗動力學」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
下游反應受限會在母物已下降時累積中間產物。 在「反應序列與中間物」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「孔隙堵塞與流速變化」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「介質耗盡與負荷波動」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「牆內外井網驗證」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「壽命、維護與證據交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
pitfallsEn: Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Plume and conceptual barrier position flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Different screen depths or measurement times can create a false horizontal gradient. Mark where this error can enter the Passive flow and hydraulic matching flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Reactive medium and usable capacity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Increasing wall resistance can divert the plume; internal concentrations alone can miss bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Wall thickness and contact time flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Column-test kinetics flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

A downstream bottleneck accumulates intermediates even while the parent declines. Mark where this error can enter the Reaction sequence and intermediates flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Pore clogging and velocity change flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Media exhaustion and loading variation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Inside/outside monitoring network flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Life, maintenance and evidence handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

courses.summaryEn: The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison.
